component.name: MPMB Reader
component.summary: Native desktop reader for MPMB interactive PDF character sheets

description.p: MPMB Reader is a native Rust desktop application built to run original MorePurpleMoreBetter (MPMB) interactive 5e/2024 PDF character sheets without Adobe Acrobat Reader. It pairs QuickJS for live Acrobat-style form state and calculations, lopdf for interactive PDF persistence, PDFium for page rendering, and a themed Dark/Light desktop interface with a live Character Quick-Card, field inspector, bookmarks, and native dialog support.
Initial packaged release with refreshed Dark/Light desktop UI, projection caching, and cross-platform builds.
